WITH state_totals AS (
  SELECT c.state_county_province, SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS transaction_total
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Accounts a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
), state_shares AS (
  SELECT state_county_province, transaction_total,
         transaction_total / NULLIF(SUM(transaction_total) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM state_totals
), above_average AS (
  SELECT transaction_total, share,
         share - AVG(share) OVER () AS excess_share
  FROM state_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM state_shares)
)
SELECT SUM(transaction_total) AS combined_transaction_total,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(excess_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_average;
